Description: authority is the address of peggy admin or governance account
token_address is the address of rate limited token
unique ID used to obtain the notional USD value of the ERC20 token from oracle
new_rate_limit_usd is the new notional limit (on withdrawals) in USD
new_rate_limit_window is the new length of the sliding window
new_token_oracle_type is used to obtain the USD price of the ERC20 token (in relation with token_price_id)
